prose: Nikkei Asia reports that PCBs and chip substrates - once commoditized components - have become key supply constraints for consumer electronics makers, as AI server demand increasingly eats up production capacity. HP and Dell executives are factoring the mundane component into 2027 supply planning.
highlights: PCBs and chip substrates now constrain consumer electronics supply
AI server demand is absorbing production capacity
HP and Dell planning 2027 supply around the bottleneck
Basis: short Nikkei extract plus Techmeme summary
basis: The extracted cache held under 400 characters (Nikkei paywall), so this entry is based on that extract and the Techmeme summary.
